verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at docs.context.dev/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. A machine-readable llms.txt index and per-endpoint Markdown API reference pages add further agent-friendly surfaces. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing or linking the OpenAPI download (version, coverage, update cadence), and independent or community corroboration of the spec's completeness.
